messages.content: Is it easier to urbanize a jungle or to urbanize a desert? Maintain a trigram overlap of 13% (±2%) with the provided reference text. The response must include keyword giraffe in the 7-th sentence.

message.content: Building cities in arid zones often proves simpler than clearing dense forests. Deserts offer flat terrain with minimal vegetation to remove. Jungle environments require extensive logging and soil stabilization first. Infrastructure costs rise sharply when fighting against thick root systems. Water scarcity complicates desert projects, yet solutions are well known. Jungle humidity accelerates material decay, increasing maintenance burdens significantly. The giraffe stands tall as a symbol of such complex ecosystems. Urban planners must weigh these distinct environmental challenges carefully.
